interface.title: Interface
interface.notificationPositionDesc: Inda sanarwar toast suka bayyana. A kan Windows, tsoho yana ƙasa-dama don haka buɗaɗɗen ba sa rufe sarrafa taga.
interface.showTokenSpeedDesc: Nuna alamu/sauki da ƙidayar alamar layi a ƙasan saƙon mataimaka. Lokacin kashewa, ƙaramin gunki yana nuna cikakkun bayanai akan dannawa.
interface.coloredUserBubble: Kumfa saƙon mai amfani mai launi
interface.coloredUserBubbleDesc: Yi amfani da launin lafazin azaman bangon saƙonninku. Idan aka kashe, suna daidaita saƙon mataimaka tare da rubutu bayyananne akan tsaka tsaki.
interface.renderHtmlArtifactsDesc: Ƙara shafin samfoti zuwa HTML da tubalan lambar SVG. HTML yana gudanar da shafin da aka samar da ƙira a cikin akwatin yashi wanda ke aiwatar da rubutun kansa amma ba zai iya samun damar Jan, fayilolinku, ko hanyar sadarwa ba; SVG yana nunawa a tsaye tare da kashe rubutun. Kashe ta tsohuwa.
interface.autoGenerateTitleDesc: Takaita sabbin tattaunawa ta atomatik zuwa taken zaren. Kashe don kiyaye tsohuwar take har sai kun sake suna da kanku.
interface.appMainViewDesc: Saita launi na bangon babban abun ciki.
interface.primaryDesc: Saita launi na farko don sautunan magana.
interface.accentDesc: Zaɓi launin lafazin da aka yi amfani da shi a cikin UI.
interface.destructiveDesc: Sanya launi mai haske don ayyuka masu lalacewa.
interface.resetToDefaultDesc: Sake saita duk saitunan dubawa zuwa tsoho.
interface.resetInterfaceSuccessDesc: An mayar da duk saitunan dubawa zuwa tsoho.
interface.threadScrollDesc: Zaɓi yadda tashar kallon taɗi ya kamata ta amsa lokacin da sabbin saƙonni suka zo.
interface.threadScrollFlowHint: Yana kiyaye wurin kallo zuwa sabon saƙon da kuka aika.
interface.threadScrollStickyHint: Yana bi ta atomatik tare da rafi na martani a cikin ainihin lokaci.
interface.tokenCounterCompactDesc: Nuna ma'aunin alamar a cikin shigarwar taɗi. Lokacin da aka kashe, lissafin alamar yana bayyana a ƙasan shigarwar.
interface.showLineNumbersDesc: Nuna lambobin layi a cikin tubalan lamba.
interface.resetCodeBlockStyleDesc: Sake saita salon toshe lambar zuwa tsoho.
interface.resetCodeBlockSuccess: Salon toshe lambar nasara cikin nasara
interface.resetCodeBlockSuccessDesc: An mayar da salon toshe lambar zuwa tsoho.

hardware.name: Suna
hardware.enableVulkanDesc: Yi amfani da Vulkan API don haɓaka GPU. Kada ku kunna Vulkan idan kuna da NVIDIA GPU saboda yana iya haifar da matsalolin daidaitawa.
hardware.noDevicesDesc: Babu GPUs da ke bayyane ga injin llama.cpp. Samfuran za su yi aiki akan CPU.
hardware.engineRestartedForDevices: GPUs ɗinku sun canza, don haka an sake kunna injin gida. Samfura suna sake yin lodi akan amfani na gaba.
hardware.engineBusyDevicesChanged: GPUs ɗinku sun canza, amma samfurin yana aiki. Dakatar da shi, sannan danna Refresh don amfani da sabon GPU.
hardware.backendApiDesc: Ta yaya llama.cpp yayi magana da wannan GPU
hardware.backendSelectDesc: Yi amfani da wannan API don wannan GPU
hardware.unifiedMemoryDesc: GPU yana raba wurin ajiya guda ɗaya tare da CPU - samfuran suna zana daga ƙwaƙwalwar ajiya iri ɗaya da sauran tsarin.

httpsProxy.proxyUrlDesc: URL da tashar jiragen ruwa na uwar garken wakili.
httpsProxy.authenticationDesc: Takaddun shaida don uwar garken wakili, idan an buƙata.
httpsProxy.noProxyDesc: Jerin runduna mai waƙafi don ketare wakili.
httpsProxy.ignoreSsl: Yi watsi da Takaddun shaida na SSL
httpsProxy.ignoreSslDesc: Ba da izinin sa hannu ko takaddun shaida. Ana iya buƙatar wannan don wasu wakilai amma yana rage tsaro. Kunna kawai idan kun amince da wakilin ku.
httpsProxy.proxySslDesc: Tabbatar da takardar shaidar SSL lokacin haɗi zuwa wakili.
httpsProxy.proxyHostSslDesc: Tabbatar da takardar shaidar SSL na mai masaukin wakili.
httpsProxy.peerSslDesc: Tabbatar da takaddun shaida na SSL na haɗin ƙwararru.
httpsProxy.hostSslDesc: Tabbatar da takaddun shaida na SSL na masu masaukin baki.

webSearch.title: Binciken Yanar Gizo
webSearch.description: Bari samfura su bincika kuma su karanta gidan yanar gizo ta amfani da ginanniyar kayan aikin Jan.
webSearch.enableDesc: Tallata kayan aikin web_search da web_fetch zuwa ƙirar da ke goyan bayan amfani da kayan aiki. Yana aiki daga cikin akwatin ba tare da maɓallin API ba.
webSearch.providerDesc: Zaɓi ƙarshen baya wanda ke amsa web_search da web_fetch.
webSearch.apiKeyOptional: Na zaɓi. Samar da maɓalli na {{provider}} API don mafi girman iyakoki da ingantaccen sakamako. Bar komai don amfani da maɓalli maras maɓalli kyauta.
webSearch.apiKeyRequired: Da ake bukata {{provider}} yana buƙatar maɓallin API don dawo da sakamako.
webSearch.endpointDesc: Da ake bukata Tushen URL na misalin {{provider}} naku, tare da kunna JSON API.

cowork.title: Cowork
cowork.description: Sanya saman wakili na Cowork: harsashi mai yashi, tare da abubuwan tunawa da ƙwarewa da aka adana su dindindin a cikin babban fayil ɗin bayanan Jan.
cowork.shellSandboxed: Dokokin da {{backend}} ke aiki da su: za su iya rubutawa a cikin filin aiki kawai, kuma fayilolin da ke cikin babban fayil ɗin ku ba za su iya karantawa ba.
cowork.shellUnavailable: Babu akwatin yashi akan wannan tsarin, don haka ba a bayar da kayan aikin harsashi ba. Ba a taɓa gudanar da umarni ba a tsare.
cowork.networkDesc: Bari umarnin Cowork su isa hanyar sadarwar, don abubuwa kamar shigar da fakiti ko ɗauko maajiyar. Kunna ta tsohuwa. Babban harsashi na babban taɗi baya samun damar hanyar sadarwa.
cowork.noMemories: Babu abin tunawa tukuna. Samfuran suna ƙara su da kayan aikin memory_write yayin da suke koyon abubuwan da suka cancanci kiyayewa.
cowork.noSkills: Babu fasaha tukuna. Ƙwarewa saitin umarnin sake amfani da samfur zai iya ɗauka akan buƙata.
cowork.editMemoryDesc: Maudu'i ɗaya a kowane bayanin kula. Samfuran suna karanta waɗannan baya tare da kayan aikin memory_read.
cowork.editSkillDesc: Umarnin Markdown, ba na zaɓi tare da kwatance a fagen gaba na YAML. Bayanin shine abin da samfurori ke gani kafin loda fasaha.
cowork.loadFailed: An kasa loda wurin aikin wakili
cowork.revealFailed: An kasa buɗe babban fayil ɗin

localApiServer.description: Gudanar da uwar garken OpenAI mai jituwa a cikin gida.

localApiServer.runInBackgroundDesc: Rike uwar garken yana gudana a cikin tire na tsarin lokacin da taga yana rufe. Lokacin kashe, rufe taga yana barin Jan kuma yana dakatar da uwar garken.

localApiServer.trustedHostsDesc: An ba runduna damar shiga uwar garken, wanda aka raba ta waƙafi.
localApiServer.corsDesc: Ba da izinin buƙatun asali zuwa uwar garken API.
localApiServer.verboseLogsDesc: Kunna cikakken rajistan ayyukan uwar garken don gyara kuskure.

localApiServer.defaultModel: Tsohuwar Model Na gida uwar garken API
localApiServer.defaultModelDesc: Samfurin gida don lodawa ta atomatik lokacin da uwar garken ya fara.
